# Public data test fixtures

`umbra-metadata.json` is a genuine public Umbra vendor metadata sidecar, pretty-printed without changing its data fields. Source: [Umbra public S3 metadata](https://umbra-open-data-catalog.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/sar-data/tasks/Bingham%20Copper%20Mine/9c39dad2-3539-4a7a-b755-47278c11fc96/2024-08-28-18-05-33_UMBRA-08/2024-08-28-18-05-33_UMBRA-08_METADATA.json). Provider: Umbra Lab Inc. Acquisition: August 28, 2024; accessed October 23, 2026. The [AWS dataset registry](https://registry.opendata.aws/umbra-open-data/) specifies [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); see the [source/license verification](../../../../docs/worldview-sar-sources.md) and [data notices](../../public/worldview-sar-notices.txt). The sidecar itself does not carry a per-object license field. Public provider collect/task identifiers in this fixture are provenance, not user observations or access credentials. Tests never fetch it from the provider automatically.
